reviews.text: Kriser’s streeterville has amazing staff! We stop in daily so Rollie can say hi to all of her favorites! Everyone is very friendly and knowledgeable about all of the products. If they don’t have it in the store, they’re checking the computer to see if another store has any in stock. You can’t go wrong shopping at Kriser’s.
The team at the Streeterville location is wonderful... friendly and super helpful. My dog routinely drags me to Kriser's like her life depends on it!

Great team, great selection , slightly higher than I’d like prices. Gonna specifically shout out for Fen and Joseph but the staff makes the higher price point worth it. Knowledgable, kind, and generally happy to help.
Great choices and staff!
Great selection of toys and treats!
High-quality dog food.  Love the sales.  Streeterville Location is very convenient

You're looking for a good deal on pet supplies? This Chicago shop has quality items that won't break the bank. I found what I needed for my furry friend at a fair price, though the selection for smaller animals could be a bit more extensive.
Everyone is so friendly when I call in an order and the courier service is fantastic.
My dog’s favorite place in Chicago is Krisers!
Jordan is always nice and does a beautiful job grooming Poppy.

$90 for below average grooming. Gave them a few chances yet each time it’s not done as requested. And then I have to put with the entitlement and audacity when they ask for a generous tip…. Yea right. Will be taking our business elsewhere.

I am posting about the store itself, not the grooming. My dog’s only need baths, and nail trims.  I live within walking distance to the Streeterville location in Chicago. This location has top quality dog food choices, which I purchase Zewi and Dr. Martin’s. It’s always a nice surprise receiving coupons in an email. The staff are friendly and helpful
Great friendly staff and plenty of options for all your furry friends

Zero stars. AVOID this place for dog grooming. This place is an absolute disaster. They have cut my dog and sent her home bleeding without telling me, for me to discover once I get home. They have tried to send her home with another dog’s harness. All on top of terrible customer service. Stay FAR away from this place when it comes to grooming services and in general if you would like  positive a shopping experience in return for overpriced items!
Excellent selection of products and most friendly people ever.
Very courteous reps, willing help store is clean and easily you can find items you want for your fur babies.
Very friendly staff! Good stuff. Got toys for cats 😀 …

I will give zero stars if possible. I took my dog for a full groom there and they treated her a shit. The groomer don’t love animal how can you pick a profession to work with animals? Don’t come here for any services. I should have realized it and called it out when making appointments. They are rude and they don’t care about animals or treat people with respect.
Jordan did an amazing job grooming my dogs. My Golden Retriever’s haircut is wonderful!!
Very great store!! Has many great quality options and the store workers are friendly and helpful!!!
Everyone here is so patient and sweet. I take my dog here for grooming and the job is well done every time! 💛 …

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. I couldn't be more disgusted with the service I just received.

Since zero stars isn't an option they get one. My dog was scheduled for grooming and he was wasn't being too co-operative. Told me they gave him a bath and we should come and get him.

They proceeded to charge me $50 for a bath, the full grooming is $65. $50 for a bath!!!!!!!

I couldn't be more disappointed, I've been going there for years for food and grooming for all three of my dogs.

You've just lost a customer for life!!!!
Friendly, knowledgeable and very helpful! Great people work here!

THIS REVIEW IS ABOUT THE CUSTOMER SERVICE.
Today I took my dogs for a nail grind service. The dog groomer was great. They always are but I am giving 1 star to this place because of the customer service, specifically the front desk employee named "JODY." I've been taking my dogs here for the last 5 years. A year ago I adopted 2 Chihuahuas and since then they have gone for several grooming sessions. They obviously have on file their vaccinations records. You can't get service without that. Jody tells me he does not have them on file. He only has Balthazar's ( my dead dog). I have sent them months ago. They would have never be seen without them. He started talking to me loudly. He is a large, tall White man. Very intimidating. People started looking at him ( he was facing me so he could not see how they were starting at him). I started looking for my dog's vaccinations. I asked him to lower his voice and he said "this is how I speak."  "If you can't provide this , we'll have to refuse service." I did not reply as I realized I was talking to a non-reasonable person. I found the docs and the pets were taking care of. I will not return and I feel this employee needs to learn how to respectful to clients, specially women.

First time in the store, walked with my husband and our purchase to the counter where two employees sat. Both were looking at computer monitors and neither greeted me or said a thing until I felt awkward and decided I must be standing at the wrong place and walked to a lower counter. I was instructed that I had been at the correct one to begin with. With no other customers in the store, this interaction came off as rude. If they were busy, they could have asked me to wait.
Great place to pick up some treats for our four legged friend.

I love having this store in my neighborhood! They sell mostly high quality brands of pet products. There're discounted items from time to time - I've found great deals on quality toys, harnesses, etc.

It's very convenient for me to come and grab frozen raw dog food whenever I run out. I don't ever need to stock up my freezer since the store is a few minutes walk.

Placing orders online and then picking the goods up in store is always fast and convenient.

We've met quite a few different staff and everyone has always been pleasant!
Excellent services!
Helpful staff and a little on the pricey side. But nothing is too expensive for our precious fur babies!
Jordan did an amazing job for my two fur boys!

Jordan (groomer) is an absolute miracle worker.  We have a VERY reactive Aussiedoodle who loathes getting groomed; in the past, we had three or four groomers who called us 20 minutes in and said they couldn't groom her because she wouldn't cooperate.  Then we found Jordan, who has somehow managed to groom her (well, at that) several times.  We don't know what we'd do without her.
Thanks for the 5 stars!  See you next time!
Wren, thanks for the 5 stars! See you next time!
Thanks for the 5 stars! See you next time!
Great selection of products
Very good service and price
Christopher, thanks for the 5 stars! See you soon!
Cheryl, thanks for the 5 stars! See you soon!

Love this place! Cassie and Joel are awesome and we love going in to say hi. My dog loves getting groomed here, she’s always excited when we walk over. I ask her if she wants to go to the “beauty shop” and she perks up when I say “let’s go see Mr Joel and Miss Cassie!” That makes me feel that she is treated well when in their care. 10 outta 10 from me! And anyone saying their dog got a “bad cut” relax. It’s hair. It grows back. Your dog is cute just the way they are hair or not! Be nicer. I bet it’s hard to cut dog hair for goodness sake. It ain’t that serious yall. Live and let live and be thankful the people here care about the dogs. That’s what counts!!
The Streeterville staff and store are simply 5 stars all the way around.   The staff at store is always friendly and welcoming.
Kathy, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you soon!
Great place!!!

We feel so lucky to have this store nearby us. Their selection of food is high quality, and our dog loves getting her pig ear as a treat whenever we stop in. :)

We also are a HUGE fan of their groomer, Jordan! Chai always comes back look UNBELIEVABLY cute from them, and they are our preferred groomer for her hands down!

Joel is such a sweetie, so kind and helpful on our last visit to the store. We have a collection of cute toys, treats and baubles for our pets from here over the last several years.  Everyone who worked there was kind, Joel especially so.

Thank you, we will miss you guys!
Don, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you next time!
Ramsey, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you soon!
Service was excellent.
Shane, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you soon!
Great staff in a perfect location!
Amy, thanks for the 5 stars. So happy to help! 🐾 …
